mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vendor_applications (user_id, stall_name, stall_description, owner_name, phone, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{stallName}, #{stallDescription}, #{ownerName}, #{phone}, 'PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, stall_name, stall_description, owner_name, phone, status, reject_reason, created_at FROM vendor_applications WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, user_id, stall_name, stall_description, owner_name, phone, status, created_at FROM vendor_applications WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id
